# proxmox_sdn_dns_providers (Data Source)

Lists staged SDN DNS providers from `/cluster/sdn/dns`, sorted by `dns`. Provider keys are not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_sdn_dns_providers" "powerdns" {
  type = "powerdns"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Restrict the result to one DNS provider type. An empty value disables this filter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this data source call.
- `servers` (Attributes List) Matching DNS providers, sorted by `dns`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `dns` (String)
- `pending` (Map of String)
- `state` (String)
- `ttl` (Number)
- `type` (String)
- `url` (String)
